author: ex_optic
body:
Hi, Im OpticSlinky and I was banned for Fast Ladder- X-ray, and No Head...

I would first like to say yes, I had fast ladder and X-ray. I had not had them for long because I was horrible at pvp before and I thought I would be better if I had them and I realize now that it just makes everything worse and that was probably one of the worst decisions I have ever made. Let me tell you how this happened:

I was with my friend (irl) named Rippling, She also plays on Avicus, and we were screwing around. We were talking about how horrible and easy it was to get hacks and that we should get it. She didn't have her laptop so we did it on mine. We were looking at the "packs" you could get and I said I didn't want them incase I did get caught, In this case I did, I didn't want to be banned permanently. I thought since I had X-ray, that I would be temped, and fast ladder was a small one so I didn't know. I was stupid to download them and go on Avicus and I don't know what I can say, but it was only for that night, I also don't know how to prove to you that I will never ever use them again, but I'm shaking right now because this is really the only server I go on.

I have donated to this server twice, and have applied and successfully became a Jr. Mod, and have invite many people to join the server. I have a team, I go on TeamSpeak, and have been creating a map with _Rilo. I have done as much as I can on Avicus to show my love for it, and I just don't know what else to say, The Mods on here know what there talking about and I have always aspired to be one, clearly thats never going to happen anymore. When I first joined Avicus, I only played Nebula. I was horrible and was kicked because I didn't know you could report and when I found out I kinda over used it, and I would send in reports to the Avicus email saying someone was hacking but I didn't really know because I was a noob. I now know how important Avicus is and how I have met new people, and made some really, really awesome friends. Honestly, I want to be Unbanned, but I see why you did ban me, so If you believe you shouldn't, Then don't. The Mods and Sr. Mods, and Admins and everyone who is Staff know what they are talking about. So I am not really thinking that I will be Unbanned, but I knew you could do this so I gave it a shot... 

Thank You for whatever Staff read this and I really, REALLY hope you consider it. :c

-OpticSlinky

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

The amount of time, effort and honesty in this appeal is amazing, however you made your own decisions and they were the wrong ones and you must face the consequences, however the many points you've stated to why you should be given a second chance gives me a difficult decision to make, but considering the fact you were only banned yesterday I am not ready to unban you right now, that being said if you appeal again in 2-3 months I can most likely guarantee your unban.
-Denied

Regards,
Auratix_,
Senior Moderator
